summary: Verified the Projects modal fix on https://himalayan.preview.emergentagent.com at 1920x1080. The project card click now opens a CENTERED MODAL POPUP (not a full-screen panel), the left copy column and right gallery column share an identical bottom edge (0px diff), all gallery navigation (next/prev arrows, dots) works, escape and backdrop-click both close the modal, and different projects load different galleries with the active dot reset to 0. All 8 requested verification points PASS. One minor content issue: the sky-gangtok thumb-1 image URL is broken (naturalWidth=0).

issues: Right-column thumb-1 image URL fails to load (https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1600585154347-be6161a56a0c?w=1600... returns 404 / naturalWidth=0). The browser shows the alt text 'Sky Gangtok — view 2' instead of an image. Replace this Unsplash URL in /app/frontend/src/lib/siteData.js (sky-gangtok project, gallery[1]).

close_behaviors.backdrop_click_closes: true (opacity=0, pointer-events=none after click on data-testid='project-drawer-backdrop')

gallery_navigation.dot_2_click: active dot index becomes 2 (widths: [9.3,9,23.7,9,9]) and main image src updates to 3rd gallery URL

action_items: (Minor) Replace the broken Unsplash URL for sky-gangtok gallery image #2 (currently photo-1600585154347-be6161a56a0c) in /app/frontend/src/lib/siteData.js — it loads with naturalWidth=0 and exposes its alt text 'Sky Gangtok — view 2' in the UI.
critical_code_review_comments: Modal layout implementation is solid: position:fixed inset:0 backdrop, .project-drawer__inner with max-width:1320px, max-height:calc(100vh - 30px), border-radius:22px, drop-shadow — produces a proper centered popup. Backdrop has its own data-testid for click-to-close, which is great for testability.

Two-column equal height achieved via grid + align-items:stretch on .project-drawer__layout and flex column with justify-content:space-between on .project-drawer__copy. Measured bottoms align at exactly 0.0px on a 1920x1080 viewport.

data-testid coverage is excellent: project-drawer, project-drawer-backdrop, project-drawer-main-image, project-drawer-thumb-1/2, project-drawer-dot-0..4, project-drawer-next, project-drawer-prev, project-drawer-enquire-*. Easy to automate.

Minor: data-testid='project-drawer-main-image' is set on the wrapper
, not the inner . This is fine but worth noting for any future test that wants to read .src directly — must query the inner img. Could optionally move the testid to the itself for ergonomic parity with the thumbs/main src reads.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (8/8 requirements PASS; 1 unrelated minor content issue: broken image URL)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Modal popup + equal-height columns fix on the Projects section is fully verified at 1920x1080. To re-test: navigate to root URL, click [data-testid='project-card-himalayan-heights'], then evaluate getBoundingClientRect on .project-drawer__inner (expect ~1320 x ~695), .project-drawer__copy and [data-testid='project-drawer-gallery'] (expect identical .bottom). Next/prev arrows: data-testid='project-drawer-next' / -prev. Dots: data-testid='project-drawer-dot-{0..4}'. The main image is the INSIDE the wrapper div data-testid='project-drawer-main-image'. Backdrop is data-testid='project-drawer-backdrop'. Escape and backdrop-click both close (opacity→0, pointer-events→none).
rca of the issue: N/A — the previously reported issues (full-screen panel; unequal column heights) are both resolved. The only remaining (minor, unrelated) issue is a broken Unsplash URL for one thumbnail of the Sky Gangtok project; replace the URL in siteData.js.
